prompt:
Create ONE brand-new high fidelity 2D GAME SPRITE ATLAS of Sunny from Metal Gear Solid 4 PS3, faithfully matching the supplied actual original-game reference frames. This is a normal fully clothed child character in harmless nonsexual game support poses. This is NOT a weapon or fighting sheet. Use detailed clean illustrated sprite art with crisp silhouette and restrained original-game material colors, not chibi or adult anime. The actual child age and clothing are crucial. Original PS3 MGS4 Sunny in the Nomad kitchen after Naomi gives her a small blue rose: short pale silver blond bob with long side fringe, soft round seven-year-old face, blue rose hair clip on anatomical LEFT temple. Black long sleeved high-neck sweater, blue-gray full length jeans, ordinary dark closed flat shoes, white plain full cooking apron with white shoulder straps crossing at back and a waist tie. NO grown-up body, NO adult makeup, no high heels. Every pose remains fully clothed with actual child proportions: approximately 4.8 heads tall, short arms and short legs, age seven. The apron is a household cooking apron, not a nurse costume or dress. No green ear protectors or gloves: those belong to the older MGR version. Shoes are conservative closed dark flats because original chosen camera obscures fine shoe detail; do not invent combat boots or decorations.
Wide landscape 3:2 native transparent RGBA PNG, around1536x1024. EXACTLY twelve separate COMPLETE single-person fullbody poses in a clean regular grid FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS. All twelve have the SAME scale and same costume and proportions. Leave large transparent gutters at least25pixels around each complete figure; absolutely no overlap, neighbor fragments, edge clipping, cut off feet, hair, hands or apron. Each pose occupies just its own cell. No labels, numerals, text, background, ground, shadows, weapons, effects, extra people or collage pieces.
All twelve Sunny bodies face SCREEN LEFT, nose and toes oriented mainly left, side-on or gentle three-quarter same direction. This is independently drawn LEFT art, do not mirror another sheet. Keep the blue/violet rose on her anatomical LEFT temple even when on the far side/occluded; do not move it onto the near right temple. Anatomical details consistent with original character, no gray beard or soldier body. Frame order row major left to right: 1. quiet upright idle, hands relaxed at sides; 2. second upright idle, one small weight shift; 3. walking leading foot forward; 4. walking passing step; 5. walking opposite foot forward; 6. walking returning passing step; 7. protective open palms held near chest; 8. protective crossed forearms lowered slightly; 9. compact crouch with both feet complete; 10. low crouch looking ahead; 11. small hop lifting heels and bending knees; 12. soft landing with knees bent. Every seated/crouched pose has complete whole clothing, legs, closed shoes and natural child posture. A genuinely separate full child per cell; no duplicate idle filling the grid. Each is a safe friendly engineer/cook or natural evasion/rest animation. No injury, nudity or sexualization. Reference screenshots are only to extract Sunny costume/face; do not draw Naomi, Snake, Raiden, aircraft, cabinets or the original scene. SheetA directionLEFT. Use the final atlas as STYLE and IDENTITY reference, but draw this LEFT sheet independently, NEVER mirror it. Anatomical LEFT temple is NEAR and must show the original blue/violet rose. Keep genuine child age and exactly same covered outfit.
